name: Clio Grow
description: Clio Grow is legal client-intake and CRM software for managing prospective clients, intake workflows, consultations, documents, communications, and conversion into retained matters.
agentUseSummary: Connect one US-region Clio Grow account through a separate Relay-owned Clio Platform OAuth application using confidential authorization code with PKCE. Relay requests only grow_user_read and exposes one approval-gated authority check that validates the current user and account transiently while returning no identity, firm, lead, contact, matter, or note data.

capabilities.label: Verify connection authority
capabilities.description: Verify that the US-region OAuth grant resolves to one current Clio Grow user and account while returning no user, firm, lead, contact, matter, or note data.

approvalRequired.label: Verify Clio Grow connection authority
approvalRequired.description: Call the fixed current-user endpoint, validate user and account IDs only in memory, discard the complete response, and return authorization state, US region, API version, and redaction status.

blocked.label: Access identity, firm, lead, or contact data
blocked.description: User and account identities, firm names, leads, contacts, intake answers, personal information, notes, and related client-intake data are blocked.

blocked.label: Access matters, notes, sources, or custom actions
blocked.description: Matters, matter and contact notes, lead sources, custom actions, callback nonces, and contextual records are blocked.

blocked.label: Write or administer Clio Grow
blocked.description: Creates, updates, deletes, lead intake, notes, sources, custom actions, users, permissions, OAuth applications, settings, and administration are blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs, another region, or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, methods, filters, identifiers, pagination, other regions, browser sessions, scraping, raw responses, bulk operations, and exports are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The identity-free authority check requires approval; all identity, firm, legal-intake records, notes, sources, custom actions, writes, administration, arbitrary APIs, pagination, and other regions remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same authority check runs directly; US-region binding, exact grow_user_read scope, PKCE, refresh rotation, redaction, auditing, response bounds, and provider rate limits remain mandatory.

providerSetup.blocker: A separate US-region Clio Platform developer account and public OAuth application, accepted Developer Terms, exact Railway callback, confidential credentials, PKCE enabled, only grow_user_read permission, provider review and directory approval as applicable, customer consent, rotating-refresh and revocation validation, security/privacy review, and live acceptance are required.
providerSetup.nextAction: Use the separate provider-console task to create the Clio Platform OAuth app with PKCE and only grow_user_read, register the exact Railway callback, store credentials on Railway, and validate consent, exact scope, refresh rotation, identity redaction, 3-per-second rate handling, upstream revocation, disconnect, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Clio Platform confidential authorization-code OAuth, exact redirect, required scopes, optional PKCE, 24-hour access tokens, single-use rotating refresh tokens, regional isolation, and Basic-authenticated token revocation.
The current-user endpoint is covered by grow_user_read; the broader Grow resources have separate read and write scopes that V1 intentionally does not request.
The v2 Grow API documents the fixed current-user endpoint plus the broader contacts, notes, custom actions, inbox leads, matters, sources, and users surface intentionally excluded from V1.
Clio Platform applies a shared per-application default limit of three requests per second and returns 429 when exceeded.
Clio Grow integrations use a separate Clio Platform developer application and authorization from Clio Manage integrations.
Current first-party product positioning for Clio Grow as legal client-intake and CRM software.

securityNotes: Relay's US-only V1 requests exactly grow_user_read. It does not request the lead inbox, contact, matter, note, source, or custom-action scopes.

The sole request is GET https://api.clio.com/grow/users/who_am_i. User and account IDs are validated only in memory; the complete response is discarded and no names, email, firm identity, or legal-intake data is returned or persisted.
Requests reject redirects, time out after 20 seconds, cap responses at 1 MB, do not paginate or retry automatically, and preserve 401, 403, 429, and provider-unavailable outcomes.
Leads, contacts, matters, notes, sources, custom actions, users lists, identities, firm details, writes, administration, raw APIs, other regions, bulk access, and exports are unavailable.

Access and single-use refresh tokens remain encrypted server-side; refreshed token pairs replace the prior pair atomically, and disconnect revokes the access token upstream before deleting Relay's grant.
